findings.title: Uncapped daily delay penalty
findings.deviation: Clause 4.1 imposes a penalty of 1% of the Work Order value per day of delay without a cap or exclusion for client-caused delay.
findings.impact: The vendor faces uncapped daily delay penalties without protection against delays caused by AtliQ.
findings.quote: Where the Vendor fails to deliver any assigned task by the agreed date, the Vendor shall pay AtliQ a penalty of one percent (1%) of the relevant Work Order value for each day of delay.
findings.counterPosition: 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week, capped at 5% of that milestone fee; no LDs where the delay is caused by the client; LDs are the sole and exclusive remedy for delay.

findings.title: Vesting of vendor pre-existing materials
findings.deviation: Clause 5.1 vests the vendor's pre-existing materials in AtliQ rather than licensing them.
findings.impact: The vendor loses ownership of its pre-existing tools and materials incorporated into the deliverables.
findings.quote: All work product, and any pre-existing materials of the Vendor incorporated into it, shall vest in AtliQ on creation.
findings.counterPosition: Contractor assigns all rights in the work product to AtliQ; pre-existing materials are licensed on terms that let AtliQ pass to the client what the client contract requires.

findings.title: Unilateral indefinite confidentiality obligation
findings.deviation: Clause 6.1 imposes a unilateral confidentiality obligation on the vendor only, with no fixed expiration term.
findings.impact: The vendor is subject to perpetual, non-mutual confidentiality obligations.
findings.quote: The Vendor shall keep confidential all information of AtliQ and its clients indefinitely.
findings.counterPosition: Make the definitions and obligations mutual, delete residuals (or make them mutual), delete restrictive covenants, mutual remedies (injunction may be sought by either party), fixed 2–3 year term.

findings.title: One-way uncapped vendor indemnity
findings.deviation: Clause 7.1 requires the vendor to provide an uncapped, one-sided indemnity to AtliQ for all losses arising from the services.
findings.impact: The vendor assumes unlimited indemnification liabilities without mutuality or limitation.
findings.quote: The Vendor shall indemnify AtliQ against all losses, claims, damages and expenses arising from the Services or any act or omission of the Vendor or its personnel.
findings.counterPosition: Each party indemnifies the other for third-party claims caused by its own breach or negligence; no indemnity for losses caused by the indemnified party's own negligence; indemnities subject to the liability cap (IP infringement excepted).

findings.title: One-sided limitation of liability
findings.deviation: Clause 7.2 limits AtliQ's aggregate liability to 1 month of fees while leaving the vendor's liability completely uncapped.
findings.impact: The vendor is exposed to unlimited liability while AtliQ's liability is strictly limited.
findings.quote: AtliQ's aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the preceding one (1) month. (No limit is stated for the Vendor.)
findings.counterPosition: Mutual cap of 1× fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim; carve-outs limited to fraud, wilful misconduct and breach of confidentiality; data-protection liability under a separate super-cap (e.g. 2× fees).

findings.title: 24-month post-term non-compete on vendor
findings.deviation: Clause 8.1 prohibits the vendor from rendering direct services to any client of AtliQ during the agreement and for 24 months post-termination.
findings.impact: The vendor is subject to an overly broad 2-year client non-compete clause.
findings.quote: During the term and for twenty-four (24) months thereafter, the Vendor shall not provide any services directly to any client of AtliQ.
findings.counterPosition: Delete, or limit to named competitors in a defined territory for the term only, with a mutual termination right.

findings.title: One-sided termination for convenience
findings.deviation: Clause 9.1 allows AtliQ to terminate on 7 days' notice for convenience while limiting the vendor to termination only for uncured non-payment.
findings.impact: The vendor lacks reciprocal convenience termination rights.
findings.quote: AtliQ may terminate at any time on seven (7) days' notice. The Vendor may terminate only for AtliQ's uncured non-payment.
findings.counterPosition: Payment for all services performed up to termination, including work in progress and committed costs; mutual notice period.

fine.note: No non-compliant data transfer or processing terms specified in the agreement.
No unsupportable or excessive insurance obligations imposed.
